annotations.title: Get a link to the full Competitive Hiring Report

description: Returns a link for the hiring manager. They open it on veritahire.com with the posting already filled in, enter their own work email, and get the full Competitive Hiring Report (this tool sends no email and takes no email address; VeritaHire only emails the address they type there). The report covers that posting: every employer hiring the same role within 25 miles by name, with the pay each posts and how fast each closes it, the last roles like it to close nearby, competitors' pay changes, and what reaching more applicants would cost. The first report is free. For a role the employer is PLANNING to post (no posting yet, or one we do not hold): give title + location (+ the pay being considered) instead of a posting, and the report is built from the market around that place.

location.description: For a role being planned: a US city and state ("Stockton, CA") or a ZIP code. With title and no job_url/job_id, the report is for a planned role.

pay.description: For a role being planned: the pay being considered, yearly or hourly ("95000", "$45 an hour")
